thread:
mina: Quick heads-up — after bringing up q4 for nebula-x on staging I see a consistent BLEU/chrF drop on the short-context multilingual eval (ja / zh-Hant / ko). Repro steps below and a tiny failing example. Anyone seen this pattern before?

mina: Repro command:
```
./eval_shortctx --model=nebula-x --quant=q4 --locales=ja,zh-Hant,ko \ 
  --dataset=shortctx-2026 --metrics=bleu,chrf --seed=42 --batch=64
```

mina: Quick metric diff (float32 vs q4, same prompts, token-level deterministic sampling):
```
locale   float32_bleu  q4_bleu   float32_chrf  q4_chrf
ja       32.1          27.6      49.8          44.3
zh-Hant  28.4          24.2      45.1          40.0
ko       30.2          26.9      47.0          43.2
```

mina: Example failure (ja):
src: 「吾輩は猫である。」
ref: 吾輩は猫である。
q4_out: 吾輩は である。
(note the dropped token and spacing)

oliver: Hmm that spacing in q4_out looks like a tokenization/boundary issue, not a pure generation hallucination. Did the tokenizer or vocabulary change between the two builds?

cheng: I ran tokenize-debug with both runtimes. Output differences: 
```
float32 tokenize("吾輩は猫である。") -> ["吾輩","は","猫","で","ある","。"]
q4 tokenize("吾輩は猫である。")      -> ["吾","輩","は","","猫","で","ある","。"]
```
cheng: See the extra empty token before `猫` and a split on `吾輩` -> `吾","輩`. That would explain the dropped token when detokenizing after quantized inference.

sato: We shipped unified-split v2 into tokenizers/ja in commit abc1234 last week to fix some kanbun/ruby edgecases. Could the q4 artifact be picking up an older tokenizer binary?

mina: Interesting — I pinned the model artifact used by staging to nebula-x:q4-2026-03-18 and the float run used nebula-x:float-2026-03-19 (different build timestamps). I'll verify tokenizer hash embedded in the model bundle.

cheng: Also worth checking zwnj/zwj/ideographic-space handling — mixed kanbun markers and vertical punctuation in zh-Hant examples showed similar split behavior in a separate run. I can run a short bisect if you want.

deploy-bot: Canary q4 deployment (staging) updated: rollout_id=rl-2026-1768, hosts=3/3 updated, config tokenizers/hash: 1a2b3c -> embedding: 5f6e7d. Run `deploy-bot logs rl-2026-1768` for details.

sato: :thumbsup: I'll diff the tokenizer artifacts across those two image tags. If it's an embed-time tokenizer mismatch we should hotfix the packaging.

mina: Thanks. I'll open a minimal reproducer and attach to a GH issue with the failing samples and eval logs. If anyone has quick ideas for a mitigation (fallback detokenizer, postfix joiner) that would be helpful to ship as a short-term patch.

oliver: For mitigation: we can add a detokenize pass that collapses empty tokens / zero-width chars before scoring. Not ideal but buys time.

mina: Yep — starting with a detok filter and running the canary again. Will update here with new metrics shortly.
